maya (sales): Marigold Capital POC reporting choppy interactive feel. Typical TTFT ~120ms but random spikes to 800-1400ms. Demo in 40m, can eng triage?
kai (eng-runtime): Which pool/model and any traces?
maya (sales): Hosted us-west, pool marigold-demo-1, model redwood-chat-medium. They attached a short trace showing batch_wait_ms ~160 and several kv_misses.
jin (eng-sre): Infra shows a small autoscaler bounce around 09:44 UTC and a KV shard rebalance right after -> a few pods used disk-backed KV briefly. Also queue_hold_time tail at ~140ms.
hope (solutions): For immediate customer guidance: try client-side prefill_tokens:3 and reduce client parallelism a bit. That often helps UX instantly.
kai (eng-runtime): Ops suggestion: set batch_window_ms=10 (was 60) and max_batch_size=12 for that pool, enable kv_prefetch for top prefixes, and pin min_replicas=2 during the demo window. Will trade some throughput for lower TTFT. Shall I apply now?
maya (sales): Yes please. Also they asked about Dedicated vs hosted for this - cost and guarantees.
sylvie (acct exec): Dedicated avoids noisy-neighbor rebalances and gives fixed shard assignments. We can offer a 3-month pilot at 12% off + 4k demo credits. I'll DM formal pricing.
credits-bot: applied 4000 demo credits to marigold@example.com @ 2203056802
kai (eng-runtime): Tell Marigold to run this quick trace and paste the JSON back so I can map requestId -> pod logs:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-medium","input":"<sample>","trace":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer | jq .trace
```
That returns batch_wait_ms, kv_hits/misses, requestId.
jin (eng-sre): I'm adding a pod-warmup job to prepopulate KV for top 50 prefixes during the rollout. That should remove cold-shard misses after the update.
maya (sales): They pasted a one-line trace: {"req":"r-mg1","batch_wait_ms":162,"kv_hits":0,"kv_misses":6,"model_ms":36}
kai (eng-runtime): Confirms pattern: batch_wait_ms + kv_misses -> TTFT stacks. After config push expect batch_wait_ms <25ms and kv_misses fall as warmup runs. If it persists we can pin them to a smaller quantized variant for the demo.
sylvie (acct exec): Note: lowering batch window increases per-token compute cost slightly; for the POC we'll cover demo delta in credits. For production we'll show a cost tradeoff comparison.
maya (sales): Rolling changes now and will brief Marigold on the call. Also I'll attach our SOC2 summary and retention policy per their security questionnaire.
hope (solutions): I'll add a short runbook snippet (config + prefill guidance + security notes) to the support ticket for them.
kai (eng-runtime): Rollout started @ 2203056815. Watch 95p/99p first-byte latency on the console and paste any follow-up traces. I can correlate logs once they paste requestIds.
maya (sales): Thanks everyone, pinging Marigold with the trace command and the pilot offer. :thumbsup:
